description: Convenience node-title search: list nodes of a bundle whose title CONTAINS a query string. JSON:API: GET /jsonapi/node/{bundle} with a verbose CONTAINS filter on title.

bundle.description: The node bundle (content type) machine name, e.g. "article", "page".

page_limit.description: Max records to return (→ query param page[limit]).

query.description: Text to match against the node title (CONTAINS).

name: drupal_search_content
title: Search content
